title: Recover without duplicating the request
when: A message is undelivered, parked or collapsed into an earlier message
need: Inspect message/attempt state and the earlier message when collapsed. No steering seat means parked for a successor. A turn ending sends no Fleet message. Cancellation and acknowledgement are separate explicit operations. Stale running recipients without an idle route use stopped-session resume automatically; inspect the original receipt and wake attempts before retrying.
surface: Message receipt/output -> get; Items and Sessions recovery examples.
review: Candidate source tests prove every declared surface delivers at its hook, intentional operator waits remain uncharged, exhausted native routes notify the original sender, and verified containment releases matching pending holds. Candidate recovery preserves process start-time evidence, supersedes old holds after a later delivered wake, and dates Fleet silence observations. Live release proof remains pending.
